{{SupportPage|vendor=Linksys|model=AE1200}} Appears to be manufactured by Wistron NeWeb. DNUB-C1 is the model mentioned on the sample label provided to the FCC. Mostly (?) unsupported by brcmfmac. Although the AE1200 has a BCM43235 chipset, brcmfmac only supports revision 3 and up and many AE1200s use an earlier revision that is not supported. [http://www.spinics.net/lists/linux-wireless/msg94934.html] However, some newer dongles may be supported (maybe they're using BCM43235B).
